fullPassage: Robert Schumann once said, "The laws of morals are those of art." What the great man is saying here is that there is good music and bad music. The greatest music, even if it's tragic in nature, takes us to a world higher than ours; somehow the beauty uplifts us. Bad music, on the other hand, degrades us. It's the same with performances: a bad performance isn't necessarily the result of incompetence. Some of the worst performances occur when the performers, no matter how accomplished, are thinking more of themselves than of the music they're playing. These doubtful characters aren't really listening to what the composer is saying — they're just showing off, hoping that they'll have a great 'success' with the public. The performer's basic task is to try to understand the meaning of the music, and then to communicate it honestly to others.

도덕의 법칙은 예술의 법칙이다

[조건] (1) are, art, laws, morals, of, of, the, those를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: the laws of morals are those of art
det.analysis:
본문: 'The laws of morals are those of art' — those = the laws(반복 명사 대신). 도덕의 법칙 = 예술의 법칙.

[조건 검증] the(1) laws(2) of(3) morals(4) are(5) those(6) of(7) art(8) = 8단어 ✅
det.tip: those = the laws (앞 명사 반복 대체)

questions.wa: the laws of morals are those of art
accept: the laws of morals are those of art

questions.passage: Some of the worst performances occur when the performers are thinking more of themselves than of the music they're __________ (play). These doubtful characters aren't really listening to what the composer is saying — they're just showing off, hoping that they'll have a great 'success' with the public.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: playing (연주하는)
det.analysis: play(동사) → playing(현재분사): 'they're ___' 진행형이므로 playing 필요
det.tip: they're playing = 그들이 연주하고 있는 (진행형)

questions.passage: Robert Schumann once said, "The laws of morals are those of art." What the great man is saying here is that there is good music and bad music. The greatest music, even if it's tragic in nature, takes us to a world higher than ours; somehow the beauty uplifts us. Bad music, on the other hand, degrades us. It's the same with performances: a bad performance isn't necessarily the result of incompetence. Some of the worst performances occur when the performers, no matter how accomplished, are thinking more of themselves than of the music they're playing. These doubtful characters aren't really listening to what the composer is saying — they're just showing off, hoping that they'll have a great 'success' with the public. The performer's basic task is __________, and then to communicate it honestly to others.
